annotations.description: Down or Degraded for 4 minutes. Receipt processing includes aged queues, overdue reviews, unconfirmed posting and failed notifications. Missing, stale or Unknown receipts/polling telemetry also alerts; intentional Paused does not. Query no-data/errors alert. Inspect the Payment processing group. Never replay an unconfirmed payment.
